name: POST /api/approvals/requests/:request_id/decide - Resolve a pending request (gateway)

testCases.name: 403 - no pending step of this request is assigned to the caller
400 - decision must be approved or rejected

description: Gateway request-level decision shortcut: decides the CALLER'S OWN pending step on the request through sdk-approval (so route semantics — multi-step, quorum, SLA — apply) and returns {success:true, data:<decide result>}. The request must belong to the caller's tenant and have a pending step whose approver is one of the caller's personas; otherwise 403 ("no pending step of this request is assigned to you") — an unknown or foreign request id is also 403, never confirming it exists. decision is approved|rejected and comment is required (400). decider_persona_id is optional and, when given, must be one of the caller's personas (403). A step already decided is 409. This route previously UPDATEd approval.request directly for any request id with a self-declared decider_persona_id, so anyone could approve anything.

errorCases.when: decision is not approved/rejected or comment is missing

errorCases.message: no pending step of this request is assigned to you
errorCases.when: the request is not the caller tenant's, is not pending, or has no pending step for one of the caller's personas; or decider_persona_id is not the caller's
the caller's step was decided concurrently
